svg.title: Carburizing a steel surface and the resulting carbon profile
svg.desc: a: carbon from a carbon-rich atmosphere at high temperature diffuses into the steel surface, producing a high-carbon case above a low-carbon core. b: the carbon concentration falls from the surface value Cs to the initial value C0 with depth x. The area between the profile and C0 is the carbon taken up per unit surface area. Points mark measurements every 0.25 mm.
